name: Command routing
responsibility: Turns argv and the command table into one bounded invocation
description: bin.ts runs the bootstrap of routing/operations first, then the command table in run.ts. The bootstrap takes --url and the global --text out of argv before routing; output to a pipe loses its colour unless --text asks for text. session.ts reads the global flags, the addressed vault and a help request, and dispatch.ts picks one route of the registry and runs it through runCommand of Command contract, saying whether an agent or a person reads the answer.
